description: This file defines the MockServerLogger class, which manages logging functionalities for the MockServer project, including configuration, log event handling, and integration with external logging frameworks.

classes.name: MockServerLogger
classes.description: A class responsible for logging within the MockServer framework, including configuration setup, log event processing, and output management.

methods.name: configureLogger
methods.description: Initializes and configures the Java logging system based on system properties and configuration settings.

methods.name: logEvent
methods.description: Logs a given LogEntry if it meets the criteria based on its type and log level.

methods.name: writeToSystemOut
methods.description: Outputs log entries to the system output using the provided logger, respecting configuration settings.

methods.name: portInformation
methods.description: Returns port information string for a log entry if available.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a given log level is enabled based on current configuration.
